Nederland-Sweden 5:1 – Analyse

📅 25 Jun 2026 | ⏱️ 13 min read (2564 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Spielverlagerung

⏱️ ~13 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • von Next Generation am 25.06.2026 in den Kategorien National Teams,World Cup mit 0 Kommentaren.
  • Nederland deed tegen Zweden veel beter dan tegen Japan.
  • According to recent reports, nederland speelde opnieuw vanuit een 1-4-3-3, maar liet in balbezit vanaf het begin een andere aanpak zien.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

von Next Generation am 25.06.2026 in den Kategorien National Teams,World Cup mit 0 Kommentaren.

Nederland deed tegen Zweden veel beter dan tegen Japan. Toch blijven er twijfels bestaan. Een analyse.

According to recent reports, nederland speelde opnieuw vanuit een 1-4-3-3, maar liet in balbezit vanaf het begin een andere aanpak zien. Met Brobbey als spits en Malen als nominale buitenspeler, die zijn rol niet invulde als pure breedtehouder voor één-tegen-één-situaties maar veel meer naar binnen speelde — zowel in de diepte als verbindend tussen de linies — ontstond direct een andere positionele dynamiek in de aanval. In tegenstelling tot de wedstrijd tegen Japan schoof Dumfries al vroeg door naar de voorste lijn. Van der Ven positioneerde zich niet als opbouwer in een driemanslijn naast de twee centrale verdedigers, maar stond iets hoger en meer naar binnen gericht, in de passlijn richting de brede speler op de hoogste lijn (Gakpo). Omdat Malen vaker naar binnen trok en Rijnders (samen met Gravenberch) meer vrijheid kreeg om diepteloopacties, kruisende bewegingen of simpelweg hogere posities te kiezen, had Nederland meer spelers op de hoogste lijn. Vooral Brobbey viel op door zijn slimme positiekeuze. Hij bewoog voortdurend in de directe lijn van de Zweedse drukzetter en profiteerde van de slimme vrijloopacties van Rijnders en Gravenberch. Met Van der Ven op de hoogte van de Nederlandse controleurs en Gravenberch die regelmatig verbindend speelde, het tempo bepaalde en af en toe uitzakte, had Nederland een betere balans tussen posities om zijn positiespel uit te voeren. Het Nederlandse positiespel is erop gericht om De Jong zo centraal mogelijk vrij te krijgen. Van daaruit wil men doorbreken richting één-tegen-één-situaties op de flank (Gakpo of Dumfries) of via centrale diep-kaats-diep-combinaties met Brobbey. Daarnaast fungeerde Brobbey als duidelijke aanspeelspeler voor de momenten waarop Zweden er wel in slaagde hoge druk te zetten. Dat was bijvoorbeeld het geval bij de openingsgoal, waar later nog uitgebreider op wordt teruggekomen.

In a recent development, zweden probeerde te verdedigen vanuit een passief 1-5-3-2-middenblok. Het voordeel van de Nederlandse balcirculatie was dat de ploeg door de passiviteit van Zweden op de flank en de iets lagere positionering van Gravenberch — of het licht doorschuiven van Van der Ven — de buitenste Zweedse pressinglijn al vroeg wist te doorbreken. Die lijn bestond uit de balnabije wingback, de balnabije middenvelder en de balnabije spits. Daardoor kon Nederland vervolgens in vrijwel alle richtingen vooruit spelen: langs de lijn, naar binnen of richting de vrije De Jong als anker voor de verdediging. Vooral Gakpo werd regelmatig vrijgespeeld doordat Rijnders vroeg bindende loopacties maakte. De onderlinge positionering en het risicomanagement van Nederland straalden veel meer lef en aanvallende intentie uit dan tegen Japan. In het algemeen bracht Nederland sneller en vaker spelers in posities met directe dreiging richting het doel dan in de eerste groepswedstrijd.

De Oranje-discussie rond 1-4-3-3 (1-4-1-2-3).

In klassiek 1-4-3-3-positiespel ontstaan vaak momenten waarop brede, balverre posities weinig functie hebben. Daardoor ontstaat veel symmetrie (spelers staan in een opstelling met gelijke afstanden en posities aan beide kanten) rond de bal. Die symmetrie zorgt meestal voor langere passafstanden. Tegen een laag en passief 5-3-blok zoals dat van Zweden zijn langere passafstanden eerder een nadeel. Dat is ook een van de redenen waarom verdedigen met een vijfmanslijn vaak effectief is tegen statisch positiespel. Een klein voordeel van die symmetrie is dat de grotere ruimtes kunnen worden benut voor lange centrale dribbels. Dat past echter minder goed bij het risicomanagement van het Nederlandse spel. De rekensom verandert wanneer Gravenberch met zijn dribbels grote afstanden over het veld overbrugt. Dankzij zijn kwaliteit verliest hij op dit niveau nauwelijks ballen. Op die momenten werd Nederland steeds weer gevaarlijk. Daarnaast slaagde Nederland er vaak in om asymmetrische posities (spelers staan in een ongelijke opstelling met verschillende afstanden en posities aan beide kanten) en kortere passafstanden te creëren. Vooral van links naar rechts combineerde het team zich effectief tussen de linies door. Daardoor ontstonden ideale voorzetposities voor doorgeschoven spelers als Dumfries en Gakpo. Met hun passing bereidden zij uiteindelijk bijna alle doelpunten uitstekend voor. Ook de bezetting van het strafschopgebied wordt vanzelf eenvoudiger wanneer spelers vanuit centrale zones en met kortere onderlinge afstanden de zestien kunnen aanvallen. Dat Brobbey ondanks een één-tegen-twee of zelfs één-tegen-drie situatie toch tot een schot kwam, lag overigens ook aan de defensieve zwakte van Zweden. Omdat Zweden ervoor koos om zijn halfverdedigers niet door te laten verdedigen en de laatste lijn passief te houden, had het op zijn minst voordeel moeten halen uit de numerieke meerderheid tegen Brobbey.

Wat was precies het Zweedse plan?

Recent findings suggest that omdat Zweden met zijn passieve 1-5-3-2 probeerde het Nederlandse spel meer richting Van Hecke te sturen, kwam Nederland vaker in situaties terecht waarin de rechter centrale verdediger kon indribbelen. Dankzij kleine overtalposities en de goede positionele invulling van Dumfries slaagde Nederland er regelmatig in om die veldbezettingen te creëren. Aan de linkerkant probeerde Nederland opnieuw via Gakpo naar binnen te komen. Daar werd echter ook een kwetsbaarheid zichtbaar, die voortkwam uit het vrijmaken van zowel De Jong als Gakpo aan die zijde. Door de vroege vrijloopactie van Rijnders om Gakpo een naar binnen gerichte dribbelhoek te geven, kwam Rijnders al snel hoog op het veld te staan, terwijl De Jong juist diep voor de centrale verdedigers bleef hangen. Balverliezen van Gakpo — of dat nu via een verkeerde pass of een mislukte dribbel gebeurde — zouden daardoor vrijwel automatisch leiden tot open omschakelmomenten tegen slechts vier resterende Nederlandse veldspelers. Tegenpressie is vanuit die structuur nauwelijks mogelijk. Toch weet Gakpo dit gevaar vaak individueel te beperken door zijn goede besluitvorming en zijn explosieve vervolgacties nadat hij de bal heeft afgespeeld.

It has been revealed that binnen de 1-4-2-opbouw was bovendien zichtbaar dat Nederland regelmatig gebruikmaakte van de bewegingspatronen van de Zweedse middenlinie om De Jong vrij te krijgen. Rijnders positioneerde zich hoger en centraler tussen Nygren en Karlström, terwijl Gravenberch juist lager of iets uitgezakt speelde. Daardoor ontstond voor Zweden een lastig dilemma. Wanneer zij probeerden door te dekken op De Jong, kwam óf Gravenberch vrij tussen de uitstappende spelers, óf Rijnders achter de verschuivende en uitstappende bewegingen van de Zweedse middenvelders. Vooral wanneer de opbouw richting Van der Ven verliep, werd dat zichtbaar. Daarbij moet opnieuw worden benadrukt dat Zweden achterin voortdurend een 3-tegen-1 situatie hield tegen Brobbey. De halfverdedigers stapten niet uit. Met andere woorden: Zweden koos bewust voor een ondertal in de voorste en middelste pressinglijn. Dat gold des te meer omdat Nygren regelmatig moest uitstappen richting de laag gepositioneerde Van der Ven. Het Zweedse idee was dat Nygren vervolgens van links naar rechts zou doordekken op De Jong. Dat werd echter tegengewerkt door de hoge positie van Rijnders, de kortere bewegingen van Gravenberch en de zeer diepe positie van De Jong dicht bij beide centrale verdedigers. Daardoor kwamen de Zweedse middenvelders voortdurend voor moeilijke keuzes te staan. Dat De Jong uiteindelijk zo dominant kon zijn in de controle van het spel had echter ook te maken met het gebrek aan arbeid zonder bal van de Zweedse voorste lijn. Isak en Gyökeres zetten nauwelijks druk terug, ongeacht hun positie op het veld. Daarnaast waren de dekking­schaduwen bij het sporadische drukzetten vaak onnauwkeurig gekozen. Toegegeven: tegen spelers als De Jong en Van Dijk is dat geen eenvoudige opdracht.

Een nog groter Zweeds defensief probleem.

Industry observers note that na alle kritiek op de organisatie van het Zweedse middenveld kreeg Zweden zijn eerste tegendoelpunt ironisch genoeg juist vanuit een situatie waarin het hoog druk zette in een één-tegen-één-structuur. Na een lange bal van Verbruggen richting Brobbey koos Zweden ervoor zich volledig te richten op de eerste bal. In plaats van de tweede bal tegenstandergericht te verdedigen of simpelweg door te verdedigen, concentreerden alle Zweedse spelers zich op het duel rond Brobbey. Brobbey wist de bal vervolgens uitstekend terug te leggen richting de hoog gepositioneerde Rijnders en Gravenberch. Van daaruit speelde Nederland de aanval met zijn individuele kwaliteit uitstekend uit. Ook dat moment vormt een waarschuwing voor toekomstige tegenstanders van Oranje. Wie hoog druk wil zetten, moet de verdediging van de tweede bal perfect georganiseerd hebben. Of beter gezegd: hoe voorkom je dat Verbruggen een gecontroleerde lange bal door het centrum kan spelen zonder dat je via een derde-man-combinatie over De Jong wordt uitgespeeld?

De keerzijde van de medaille: Nederlandse gaten en communicatieproblemen.

In a recent development, zweden bouwde zelf op vanuit een 1-3-2-4-1. Daartegen koos Nederland eveneens voor een agressievere aanpak dan in de eerste wedstrijd. Via naar binnen sturende buitenspelers probeerde Oranje directe man-tegen-man-situaties te creëren. Een eenvoudige maar effectieve vorm van pressing die inmiddels in het moderne topvoetbal overal terug te zien is. Brobbey koos zijn momenten om de Zweedse doelman onder druk te zetten bijzonder slim. Hij gebruikte zijn dekking­schaduw effectief tegen Nordfeldt, waardoor de Zweedse keeper regelmatig ongecontroleerde ballen speelde richting ongunstige duels voor Zweden of zelfs rechtstreeks in Nederlandse balbezitmomenten. Daardoor kon Zweden nauwelijks gecontroleerd balbezit opbouwen in de lage zones. Hoewel Nederland in balbezit duidelijke vooruitgang liet zien, kwamen bij Zweeds balbezit in het middenblok of lage blok opnieuw oude problemen naar boven. Alleen de matige afwerking van Zweden en enkele sterke reddingen van Verbruggen voorkwamen dat die problemen nog zwaarder werden afgestraft. De Jong oriënteerde zich in zijn mandekking opnieuw meer op de laatste lijn, zonder daar consequent in terug te vallen. Op teamniveau ontstonden regelmatig communicatieproblemen bij het uitvoeren van de mandekkingen over het hele veld. Vooral Malen en Dumfries stemden hun acties niet goed op elkaar af en richtten zich soms op dezelfde tegenstander. De mandekkingen van Nederland in de voorste en middelste lijn zijn bovendien vaak erg spelergericht en weinig ruimtegericht. Vooral bij tweede ballen, chaotische situaties of ongeorganiseerde fases wordt de directe tegenstander gevolgd in plaats van dat de binnenbaan wordt afgeschermd. Daardoor ontstaan problemen wanneer de laatste lijn tegelijkertijd bezig is de diepte af te dekken. Daarnaast was zichtbaar dat Van Dijk en Van Hecke minder agressief vooruit wilden verdedigen dan tegen Japan. Vermoedelijk omdat een offensieve 2-tegen-2 voor Zweden de makkelijkste manier was om tot grote kansen te komen. Door deze vrij klassieke en soms wat starre mandekking ontstaat echter oncompactheid tussen de linies. Daardoor komt er te veel ruimte vrij voor overtalspel of dribbels tussen de linies.

According to recent reports, opnieuw liet Nederland problemen zien bij het verdedigen van en richting de flank. Wederom werden de passlijnen naar die zones niet goed afgesloten door Gakpo en nu ook door Malen. Door het gebrek aan compactheid konden de Nederlandse wingbacks niet vroeg genoeg druk zetten. Daarnaast zorgde de starre mandekking van de controleurs ervoor dat spelers tussen de linies of vóór de middenlinie relatief eenvoudig vrijgemaakt konden worden. Vrijwel direct na de 1-0 kwam Zweden op die manier tot een grote kans via Gyökeres.

Recent findings suggest that op buitenspel spelen lijkt voor Nederland tijdens dit WK voorlopig geen thema. Een ander belangrijk probleem zit in de onderlinge afstemming tussen de laatste lijn en de middenlinie, met name de controleurs, wanneer tegenstanders verticale positiewisselingen maken. Met relatief eenvoudige verticale positiewisselingen in de halfspace voor Van Hecke of Van Dijk wist Zweden regelmatig vrije spelers tussen de linies te creëren die met het gezicht naar het doel konden openen. Dat kwam doordat noch Van Hecke noch Van Dijk consequent communiceerden of uitstapten, terwijl de Nederlandse controleurs de loopacties richting de laatste lijn vaak simpelweg volgden.

Nog grotere problemen na de drinkpauze.

It has been revealed that na de Zweedse omzetting naar een soort 1-4-2-3-1 of 1-4-4-2, waarbij Nygren regelmatig naast Gyökeres kwam te spelen, had Nederland in balbezit weinig problemen. Dankzij de 3-tegen-2 in het centrum kon Oranje vrijwel altijd De Jong vinden, en anders meestal Gravenberch tussen de linies. Dat kwam mede doordat Lindelöf aarzelend verdedigde wanneer hij moest uitstappen. Het gevolg daarvan was echter dat Zweden vrijwel geen druk meer op de bal kreeg. Nederland kon daardoor steeds vaker naar eigen inzicht spelen. Daar kwam nog bij dat vooral Isak naarmate de wedstrijd vorderde zowel qua motivatie als qua intensiteit zonder bal terugviel. De ingevallen Elanga, die aanvallend juist voor nieuw leven zorgde, liet tactisch in het spel tegen de bal eveneens steken vallen. Daardoor werden de ruimtes in het centrum alleen maar groter. In balbezit viel Zweden weer terug in zijn 1-3-2-4-1-structuur. Daarbij voelde Isak zich nu vaker genoodzaakt om vanaf links naar meer centrale posities door te schuiven. Dat zorgde af en toe voor kleine overtal­situaties in het centrum. Terwijl de laatste lijn van Nederland zich steeds verder liet terugzakken, bleef de middenlinie vasthouden aan haar starre mandekkingen. Alleen Gakpo en Malen probeerden iets meer naar binnen te schuiven om het centrum af te sluiten, terwijl Brobbey in ondertal — vaak één tegen twee of zelfs één tegen drie — probeerde druk te zetten. Daardoor had Nederland in principe geen duidelijke oplossing voor de Zweedse opbouw.

Dat dit zelden echt een probleem werd, lag vooral aan de slordigheid van Zweden. Ondanks meerdere slechte pressingmomenten wist Nederland steeds weer gevaarlijke omschakelsituaties te creëren dankzij fouten van de Zweden. Over het geheel genomen moet worden gezegd dat zowel de tactische discipline als de intensiteit in alle fases van het spel na de 4-0 duidelijk afnamen. Met uitzondering van Summerville en Elanga brachten vooral de invallers weinig extra energie of invloed in de wedstrijd. Aan Nederlandse zijde valt dat echter grotendeels te verklaren door een duidelijke terugval in spanning en concentratie. Hopelijk kost dat Oranje uiteindelijk niet de groepswinst. In dat opzicht was de manier waarop Summerville de 5-1 vierde eigenlijk een perfecte samenvatting van het laatste halfuur van de wedstrijd.

Wie Nederland hoog onder druk wil zetten zonder uitgespeeld te worden, heeft een uitstekend georganiseerde pressing nodig én een oplossing voor de directe druk op Verbruggen. Op WK-niveau is dat een enorme uitdaging. Laat je Nederland daarentegen spelen tegen een passieve vijfmansverdediging op eigen helft, of probeer je vanuit een ruimtegeoriënteerd middenblok naar één kant te sturen, dan zal deze nieuwe versie van Nederland je domineren en regelmatig uitspelen. Deze prestatie nodigt uit om te dromen, ook al moet de Zweedse aanpak kritisch bekeken worden. Met agressief uitstappen vanuit een vijfmansverdediging zul je tegen Nederland altijd problemen krijgen om alles te verdedigen. Tegelijkertijd levert die aanpak waarschijnlijk ook balveroveringen op. De tegenpressingstructuur en de onderlinge afstemming in de restverdediging van Oranje zijn voorlopig namelijk nog niet zo overtuigend als de opbouw en het balbezitspel. En als gedachte-experiment geldt bovendien het volgende: hoe meer dreiging een tegenstander uitstraalt in de omschakeling, hoe groter de kans dat Koeman kiest voor een voorzichtigere en meer risicomijdende aanpak in balbezit. In dat scenario zou Oranje opnieuw meer met de handrem erop gaan aanvallen.

Sources indicate that waar het spel mét bal aanleiding geeft om te dromen, kan de defensieve organisatie in een laag of middenblok nog steeds leiden tot grote kansen voor de tegenstander. Tegen sterkere landen, met meer individuele kwaliteit en een hoger niveau in hun aanvallende organisatie, zullen deze problemen waarschijnlijk nadrukkelijker zichtbaar worden.

HH groeide op aan de Nederlands-Duitse grens, maar keek op tactisch vlak liever richting Zuid-Europa. Naast zijn werkzaamheden als freelancer voor Duitse profclubs is hij sinds twee jaar ook actief als jeugdtrainer bij de O17 van N.E.C. Nijmegen.

LL ontdekte zijn fascinatie voor voetbalinhoud en tactiek dankzij de vernieuwende ideeën van Tuchel bij Mainz. In de regio rond de Narrenstadt is hij al actief geweest binnen zowel het amateurvoetbal als de jeugdopleidingen van profclubs (NLZ).

Man City sign Enzo Fernandez for £125m to end transfer saga of the summer

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Manchester City have equalled the British record transfer on deadline day after agreeing to pay £125m to sign midfielder Enzo Fernández from Chelsea.
  • The deal brings to an end the biggest saga of the summer and means that Enzo Maresca, the newly introduced City head coach, has landed his number one target.
  • It has been revealed that city left it until the last day of the transfer window to strike an agreement after Chelsea decided that Fernández’s exit was in the best interests of the club.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Manchester City have equalled the British record transfer on deadline day after agreeing to pay £125m to sign midfielder Enzo Fernández from Chelsea.

The deal brings to an end the biggest saga of the summer and means that Enzo Maresca, the newly introduced City head coach, has landed his number one target.

It has been revealed that city left it until the last day of the transfer window to strike an agreement after Chelsea decided that Fernández’s exit was in the best interests of the club. But a late move to replace the Argentine with Monaco midfielder Lamie Camara collapsed to the anger of the Premier League club, leaving Xabi Alonso one player light among his midfield options.

Having refused to meet Chelsea’s self-imposed deadline to sign Fernández for £120m earlier in the summer, City had to equal the £125m Liverpool paid Newcastle United for Alexander Isak 12 months earlier.

Fernández had made it clear that he wanted to leave Chelsea some time ago and was left out of Alonso’s squad for the victories last week over Luton Town, in the Carabao Cup, and Brighton.

Having initially wanted to join Real Madrid, Fernández set his heart on linking back up with Maresca at City. The pair share a close relationship and had kept in touch after Maresca left Chelsea at the start of the year.

This is the second time Fernández has become the most expensive player in British transfer history, having previously set the record when he joined Chelsea for £107m from Benfica in the 2023 winter window.

Introducing our upcoming Argentinian Blue 🇦🇷🩵 pic.twitter.com/nEHQ1oM855.

During his time at Chelsea, 25-year-old Fernández won the Club World Cup and the Europa Conference League but he was also at the centre of controversy.

In January 2025, Fernández posted a video of himself and some of his Argentina international team-mates singing an offensive song about France players of African origin after winning the Copa America. He apologised to his Chelsea team-mates and made a donation to an anti-discrimination charity, but was still made the team’s vice-captain.

Last season was Fernández’s best goalscoring campaign, as he netted 15 goals in all competitions for Chelsea but the club finished 10th in the Premier League table. In April, he was suspended for two games by the club for suggesting he would like to live in Madrid – which was perceived as a come and get me plea to Real Madrid.

He angered England fans with his celebration after scoring against Thomas Tuchel’s team in Argentina’s World Cup semi-final victory over England, before being sent-off in the final defeat by Spain.

Chelsea fans booed Fernández in pre-season, although the club’s travelling supporters sang his name when he was introduced as a substitute in the victory over Fulham at the start of this season.

Industry observers note that fernández thanked his team-mates and the Chelsea staff in an emotional farewell post on Instagram. He added: “I want you to know that these have not been easy days for me. Writing this is not easy either. The truth is, I haven’t been in a good place.

“Three years ago, Cobham and Stamford Bridge became home for me and my family. I grew attached to the people, to the shirt, and to the badge of this incredible club.

Industry observers note that “Believe me when I say that, from the moment I arrived, I became obsessed with winning and with bringing this club every trophy that its history deserves. We suffered, we cried, I got angry many times, but we also celebrated titles and unforgettable victories. Together, through the good times and the difficult ones.

The sale of Fernández means that Chelsea have set a latest British transfer record of their own, having secured more than £500m in sales and loan fees during the summer transfer window.

Chelsea set about spending some of the money made from the Fernández sale by agreeing a last-minute deal for Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara.

Monaco had rejected a bid of £38.5m from Chelsea on deadline day, but an improved offer of £47m was accepted late on Tuesday night, only to be called off by Monaco on the stroke of the 11pm deadline.

Chelsea had been able to complete a medical during negotiations and Camara agreed to a six-year contract with the option of a further year to bolster Alonso’s midfield options, but he will now not join the club.

Chelsea had also seen at least one offer for Bournemouth’s Alex Scott rejected this summer, while the club indicated an interest in Roma’s Manu Kone and explored whether or not a move for Arsenal’s Martin Zubimendi would be possible earlier this month.

In this scrupulously detailed account of Arsenal’s summer, Sam Dean assesses where things went right, and wrong, for the Premier League champions in the transfer market.

They have buttressed the two areas in which they were already strong by signing Bruno Guimaraes and Ezri Konsa, but failed to sign the level-raising forward Mikel Arteta coveted.

In fact, with Gabriel Jesus, Leandro Trossard and Gabriel Martinelli departing (as well as Ethan Nwaneri moving on loan), their weakest department is arguably weaker than this time last year. Christos Tzolis, signed for £34m from Club Brugge, is their only attacking purchase.

I want to thank every single one of you: the staff, the coaching team, the medical team, the physios, and everyone who works at Cobham and throughout this great institution.

To all my teammates over these years, thank you from the bottom of my heart for sharing so many moments with me. I was truly happy here, and I wish you nothing but the very best for the future.

I want you to know that these have not been easy days for me. Writing this is not easy either. The truth is, I haven’t been in a good place.

Sunderland were involved in the most bewildering transfer of the summer on deadline day as they fought a day-long tug-of-war with Crystal Palace for winger Malick Fofana.

On a day of claims and counterclaims, Sunderland have finally triumphed in the battle to land the Belgium international just an hour before the deadline.

But despite their success, it was a transfer that will leave a sour taste in the mouth to many, with the player repeatedly changing his mind about which club he wanted to join.

As the saga dragged on, it is understood Fofana had a medical in Lyon with both Sunderland and Crystal Palace given access to the information as he still could not decide which club to join as talks continued into the evening.

Sunderland had a bid of around £25m accepted by Lyon on Tuesday morning and thought they had an agreement with both the player and his agent on personal terms and fees only for Palace to make a late attempt to hijack the deal.

In a recent development, the London club’s manager, Pierre Sage, who worked with Fofana at Lyon, is thought to have personally intervened in an attempt to persuade the player to move to South London. By late afternoon, Palace appeared to have got their man having also offered more money to Lyon and higher wages to the player and fees to his agency.

Sunderland, though, refused to concede defeat and, according to reports in France, rolled out a counter proposal of their own led by French owners Kyril Louis-Dreyfus who flew to Lyon to try and clinch the deal.

At one stage, it was even claimed that the player had two different private jets waiting at the airport to take him to either London or the North East depending on who he elected to sign for.

That was later refuted, although it is understood the player did have a medical in Lyon that could be viewed by both clubs before he made up his mind. That gave his representatives more time to thrash the terms of a deal with both clubs.

However, having failed to board an earlier flight to Lyon after talks with Palace advanced, Sunderland’s late push belatedly persuaded the 21-year-old to head to Wearside, and he is due to be unveiled on Wednesday morning.

Arsenal had also been linked with the player earlier this week but were not willing to match the asking price for Fofana who they viewed as a project player.

After so long out of the game, Mudryk now has a coach who knows exactly how to get the best out of him. It might not work at all. Mudryk may need months to rediscover his match sharpness after so long out. But I am very excited to find out.

Ugarte’s serious knee injury put paid to the Uruguay midfielder leaving and Rashford has been reintergrated in the squad after Barcelona opted against taking up an option to sign him permanently.

Benfica are in talks about loaning Argentina Under-23 forward Claudio Echeverri from Manchester City, It’s likely to be a season long loan with an option to buy if finalised.

Fabio Vieira has completed his move from Arsenal to Hamburg, in a deal believed to be worth about £9m. The Portuguese midfielder has never cut it in the Premier League and it is no surprise that Arsenal have cashed in. They paid more than £30m to sign him from Porto in 2022 but he has never come close to justifying the fee. In truth, it’s one of their worst transfers under Mikel Arteta.

Southampton forward Cameron Archer is on course to sign for Auxerre on a season-long loan.

Archer has been a target for a number of Championship clubs this summer but a deal has been problematic because of his £35,000-a-week wages.

It is understood Southampton have been demanding that his salary be paid in full, which has scared off interested clubs in the second tier.

Chelsea will hold off sanctioning Enzo Fernández’s move to Manchester City until they are confident of making at least one signing of their own.

Telegraph Sport understands that Chelsea have already rejected one proposal from City for Fernández during club-to-club talks and are demanding a fee and payment terms that are favourable to them.

Chelsea also have three separate targets of their own as potential deadline signings – Lamine Camara, Manu Kone and one mystery target from the Premier League.

Monaco have already rejected a £38.5m bid from Chelsea for Camara. Roma manager Gian Piero Gasperini wants to keep Kone, although negotiations continue. And there is a third target from the Premier League, who is not believed to be Morgan Gibbs-White.

Chelsea must make significant progress on one of their targets before they will sanction Fernández’s sale – and City must make another bid that is more favourable to the club.

Sources indicate that monaco have rejected an opening €45m bid from Chelsea for midfielder Lamine Camara. It now remains to be seen if the club increase that offer.

Sunderland have been trying to sign a winger all summer and it appears that they have finally got their man in Lyon’s Malick Fofana.

Arsenal had been linked with a move for the 21-year old Belgium international.

Announcing Ansah! ✍️🔗 https://t.co/gweqxOt7aR pic.twitter.com/geZR60ZaTG.

The Argentina forward missed three training sessions last week and was not included in Diego Simeone’s squad that travelled to Sevilla last weekend.

Nueva sesión de trabajo del Atleti en Majadahonda esta mañana. Julián Alvarez entrenando con normalidad con el resto del grupo. Objetivo, intentar estar en la lista de convocados para el partido ante el Athletic. Sorloth será baja por lesión. Imagen: @jsancris_ #ClubUria pic.twitter.com/IXAWX7mwrJ.

Industry observers note that plenty of chatter about the future of Roma midfielder Manu Koné, who is linked with a move to Chelsea. The France international would be a strong acquisition for Xabi Alonso, but could his potential signing precede an Enzo Fernández exit? All will be revealed in due course...

Of Koné, former France manager Didier Deschamps mentioned: “He’s very effective at winning the ball back, but he shouldn’t be limited to that role of defensive midfielder, because he also makes a difference in his use of the ball.”.

Austria centre-back David Affengruber has emerged as potential deadline-day deal for Fulham as they look to bolster Alvaro Arbeloa’s defence.

The Elche player has been in La Liga for two years playing regularly and fits the data model at Craven Cottage.

Fulham are also trying deals for Real Madrid’s Manuel Angel and Eintracht Frankfurt’s Hugo Larsson as midfield options.

Sunderland are expected to complete the signing of centre-back Kevin Danso from Tottenham Hotspur with the player travelling to Wearside last night for the first part of his medical.

The Austria international will initially join on loan with an obligation to make the move permanent for £25m next year.

Danso had made it clear he wanted to leave Tottenham this summer in search of regular first-team football.

Eintracht Frankfurt are in talks with Nottingham Forest over another loan move for forward Arnaud Kalimuendo.

Frankfurt signed the Frenchman on loan in January and are negotiating a return for Forest’s £26m signing from Rennes.

Oliver Glasner, Forest’s head coach, had been intent on keeping Kalimuendo but it is understood Frankfurt’s strong interest has altered the club’s thinking.

Morato, the centre-back, is expected to join West Ham United on loan.

Forest are exploring potential signings but are determined to stay calm and only pursue deals that make financial sense. A winger and a No 6 are the two priority targets if there are deals to be done.

On Tuesday evening, the Tottenham and Brazil forward posted an emotional message on Instagram amid reports of a possible move back to Everton.

He wrote: “After everything I’ve been through in recent years, I decided that never again would others decide my future for me.

In a recent development, “I went through a lot of bad things during this time, and almost all of them happened because of decisions made by other people. Pressure, threats, retaliation – none of that scares me. I’ve been through worse, believe me!

Sources indicate that “I have always made it clear at every opportunity that my departure to another place would also have to be good for the club. If it wasn’t, I would never accept it... just as I didn’t accept it when everything here was falling apart and they needed me.”.

Richarlison added: “I stayed and gave my all. So, I hope they treat my situation with the same respect that I have always had for Spurs and for all the people who worked with me during this period. Just don’t try to decide for me.”.

According to recent reports, “If Spurs and Everton reach an agreement, I will return to the club of my heart. My intention was indeed to go back to the place where I was very happy.

According to recent reports, “But negotiations were being done the way other people wanted, and it won’t be that way anymore. Despite all this turmoil, I have a contract with Spurs and I will remain at the club’s disposal.”.

Sources indicate that it will be good news for Arsenal if Folarin Balogun completes his £40m move to Everton today. When Arsenal sold Balogun to Monaco in 2023, they negotiated a sell-on clause of 17.5 per cent. According to my maths, that means Arsenal will get £7m from this transfer. Not to be sniffed at!

Hull City are close to agreeing a fee of around £7.5m for Stoke City winger Sorba Thomas.

The Wales international has been a long-term target for Hull and negotiations are now approaching a conclusion.

Thomas has been pushing a move through and is expected to leave Stoke after one full season.

As has become the norm this summer Acun Ilicali has posted a cryptic message on X, which has prompted speculation among Hull City fans. The club has been linked with Everton holding midfielder Tim Iroegbunam.

Sources indicate that will Barcola hit the ground running at Anfield? The France winger registered 20 goal contributions in 49 games for Paris St-Germain last season.

A warm welcome from the skipper 😍 pic.twitter.com/95EAqUjYBn.

The La Masia graduate secures a permanent move to Germany. Who knows how his career in England would have panned out had Chelsea not recalled him 25 days into his Sunderland loan at the beginning of last season...

Marc Guiu has completed a permanent transfer to Bundesliga side RB Leipzig. Everyone at Chelsea would like to thank Marc for his efforts during his time at the club and wish him every success as he begins the next chapter of his career with RB Leipzig.

What a couple of weeks it has been for Robert Sanchez. He came into this season as Chelsea’s No 1, but after a difficult start to the campaign and Emi Martinez’s arrival, reports suggest he could be moving away from Stamford Bridge on loan. Cesc Fabregas’s Como appears the probable destination.

Trevoh Chalobah, who left Chelsea for Como last month, has taken to his “secondary” Instagram account to post the following picture...

In a recent development, meanwhile, as reported by Telegraph Sport yesterday, striker flop Nick Woltemade is moving to Juventus on a season-long loan. The club’s record signing from as year ago at £64m is moving to Turin for a £3.5m loan fee with the Serie A squad covering the full cost of his wages.

Newcastle will complete the £51m signing of forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo from Lille today but that is expected to be it in terms of incomings.

The Belgium international will become the club’s eighth signing of the summer and his versatility – he can play as a centre forward, a No 10 or out wide – means there are no more gaps to fill in the squad.

It has been revealed that in an ideal world, Newcastle would have liked to sign another defender but none of their targets were still on the market. With Dan Burn due to return from injury in a few weeks, they have four centre-backs while new arrival Amar Dedic can play on both sides as a full-back.

In a recent development, in terms of outgoings, Joe Willock and Jacob Murphy are expected to stay at the club despite interest from Nottingham Forest and Besiktas. Young striker Sean Neave will be allowed to leave on loan. The 19-year-old has offers from clubs in the Championship and League One but Newcastle want him to go somewhere he has the best chance of getting regular first-team football.

It has been revealed that city have been this summer’s selling kings and have had six players leave the club in deals worth more than £45m. Compare that to the summer when Pep Guardiola first arrived at the club, in 2016, when City generated just £23m from sales and made losses on Edin Dzeko and Stevan Jovetic, while Martín Demichelis departed on a free transfer.

Fast forward to this summer and more than £300m worth of players have been sold, with a further £60m arriving at the end of the season when Omar Marmoush’s loan to Tottenham Hotspur becomes permanent.

Given how Jaissle wants Newcastle to play, it is plain to see why Fernandez-Pardo appeals to him. Quick, direct and only 21 – he would surely fit right in at St James’ Park.

A post shared by Ligue 1 McDonald's (@ligue1mcdonalds).

The Leeds wide man has a medical booked with Fiorentina today. He made a handful of appearances for Daniel Farke’s side during pre-season but has not featured since the start of the 2026-27 campaign.

✈️ L'arrivo di Gnonto a Firenze ⚜️ pic.twitter.com/nEFngsyxQP.

Very unlikely that Liverpool will be doing any major incoming business but there may yet be some departures. Jayden Danns, who broke through three years ago and played in the 2024 League Cup final defeat of Chelsea, is attracting interest from clubs in Europe, who want to take him on loan. Danns, a promising striker, has had injury concerns and is working his way back to full fitness but his long-term ambition is to prove to Andoni Iraola that he can be part of his squad.

Recent findings suggest that fax machines are whirring as the clock continues to tick towards the transfer deadline, but who does your club need to sign? Let us know in the comments below!

Aston Villa are to confirm the signings of £50m winger Ibrahim Mbaye and £25m centre-back Taylor Harwood-Bellis this morning.

Mbaye and Harwood-Bellis takes the number of Villa’s signings this summer to 10, with Unai Emery ruling out any more additions after the 1-0 defeat by Arsenal last night.

Emery also disclosed that forward Tammy Abraham will be staying at Villa Park, amid interest from Ipswich Town.

The one player who could leave today is Jamaica international Leon Bailey, who has interest from clubs in Europe, and Hull City.

Nottingham Forest can confirm Omari Hutchinson has joined AC Milan on a season-long loan deal, with the Italian club holding an option to make the transfer permanent.Everyone at Nottingham Forest wishes Omari all the best for his time in Italy. pic.twitter.com/fSv1uNGh2Y.

Sources indicate that fulham remain locked in discussions with Rayo Vallecano to agree a fee for right-back Andrei Ratiu, with the Romania international having confirmed he wants to join Alvaro Arbeloa’s side. The spin-off with this deal is that it will accelerate Kenny Tete’s switch to Everton, for a fee in the region of £9.5m.

On the subject of right-backs, Nathan Patterson, who has had a difficult time at Everton, has been granted permission to travel to Italy to undergo a medical with Torino.

Matias Fernandez-Pardo is on the verge of joining Newcastle United, and Luke Edwards reported that the forward’s arrival is likely to pave the way for Nick Woltemade’s departure.

Recent findings suggest that the German enjoyed a fruitful start to life in England after signing last summer, scoring seven Premier League goals before the turn of the year, but could only manage one goal in the second half of the season. While Eddie Howe experimented with Woltemade in a more withdrawn No 10 role, there was a clear drop-off in his game-time after Christmas.

It has been revealed that newcastle are ready to pay around £51m to sign Fernandez-Pardo after holding face-to-face talks with Lille last week. The 21-year-old is a versatile attacker and Newcastle identified him as a top target months ago. If they can complete a deal, it could speed up the departure of Nick Woltemade, who is wanted by Juventus.

Recent findings suggest that the Brazilian has asked to leave Spurs and has been linked to a move back to Everton. However, his hopes of returning to Merseyside may have taken a hit on Monday night, when Everton agreed a £40m deal with Monaco for striker Folarin Balogun.

It has been revealed that brighton are keen to sign Azeez from Millwall and have made multiple offers for the forward. Millwall want at least £15m for Azeez, who scored 11 goals in the Championship last season. Ipswich Town have previously shown interest in Azeez.

Industry observers note that leeds are signing Melvin Bard on loan from Nice. One-season deal for the 25-year-old who will compete for a place in the first-team under Daniel Farke.

It has been revealed that we’re expecting four departures from Arsenal today. Nwaneri to Dortmund on loan (see my colleague Mike McGrath’s post below), Gabriel Martinelli to Al-Hilal, Gabriel Jesus to Barcelona and Fabio Vieira to Hamburg. Those deals should raise around £70m.

It has been revealed that will there be any incomings? The Julian Alvarez situation seems unlikely to develop in Arsenal’s favour, barring a dramatic change of heart. As reported by Telegraph Sport yesterday, Lyon winger Malick Fofana is a potential option.

According to recent reports, borussia Dortmund have been trying to close out a loan deal for Arsenal winger Ethan Nwaneri, as reported by Telegraph Sport yesterday. The German club have previously attempted to land the 19-year-old and this time want him on a deal for the season.

Recent findings suggest that it is expected to be another busy deadline day in the Premier League, with many clubs still hoping to finalise deals before the transfer window shuts at 11pm. Here, Telegraph Sport identifies 10 potential high-profile moves that could yet go through.

This has been the most dramatic and relentless saga of the European transfer window. The situation, as far as we understand it, is as follows: Barcelona want Alvarez and Alvarez wants Barcelona, but Atletico Madrid refuse to sell him to Barcelona. Arsenal want Alvarez, and Atletico are more open to selling him to Arsenal, but Alvarez only wants Barcelona. For a move to happen, it will require one party to change their mind. Either Atletico decides to sell to Barcelona, or Alvarez decides he will join Arsenal.

Recent findings suggest that another long-running saga. Chelsea are well aware of City’s interest in Fernandez but want a massive fee for the Argentina international, having initially valued him at £120m. City have the cash and the space in the squad after saying goodbye to Rodri, Tijani Reijnders, Nico Gonzalez and Bernardo Silva this summer. Fernandez has not featured in Chelsea’s last two games.

As reported by Telegraph Sport last week, Chelsea have identified Monaco midfielder Camara as a target amid the uncertainty over Fernandez’s future. French reports on Monday suggested the move may have stalled, however. The clock is ticking.

According to recent reports, spurs had been working on a deal to sign Ndiaye from Everton but they now appear to have fallen behind City in the race for the winger, as a consequence of City failing in their attempt to sign Cody Gakpo from Liverpool. City are ready to complete the hijack on deadline day.

A deal that, as of Monday night, is regarded as unlikely to happen. As with their interest in Brighton’s Yankuba Minteh, Liverpool have so far been unable to strike a deal with Crystal Palace for Sarr, who scored 21 goals in 45 games last season. Liverpool would only allow Gakpo to leave if a replacement, such as Sarr, can be signed.

Burnley are one of a host of Championship clubs who are interested in the young Manchester United left-back Harry Amass. There have been talks over a potential permanent deal but a loan cannot be ruled out. The 19-year-old joined United from Watford in 2023.

Everton have reached an agreement with Manchester City to sign Jack Grealish on another season long loan. It has been a very busy summer of outgoings at City and Grealish will be the latest to depart as he prepares to return to Merseyside. He started well at Everton last season before injury in January derailed his campaign.

A big year ahead for the English midfielder.

Tottenham are set to complete a double deal for Chelsea pair Mykhailo Mudryk and Tosin Adarabioyo after missing out on Iliman Ndiaye.

Spurs will take Mudryk on loan for the season having seen their attempt to land Ndiaye fail when Manchester City agreed a £65m deal with Everton.

Mudryk, 25, worked with Spurs head coach Roberto De Zerbi at Shakthtar Donetsk, in the winger’s homeland Ukraine, before his £85m move to Chelsea in 2023.

Leeds United had shown interest but instead he will be reunited with De Zerbi, effectively taking Ndiaye’s place as a wide-forward option.

Adarabioyo will be a permanent deal to Spurs as they are not allowed to loan two players from a Premier League club.

Good morning and welcome to live coverage of transfer deadline day. We are deep into stoppage time in this summer window and we will bring you the key developments as teams scramble to get last-minute deals over the line before the full-time whistle blows at 11pm.

Sources indicate that enzo Fernández remains a City target, and his omission from Xabi Alonso’s match-day squad against Brighton and Hove Albion on Sunday has only added weight to the feeling that he might reunite with former Chelsea head coach Enzo Maresca. City would be required to meet the Londoners’ £120m asking price, which is just shy of Alexander Isak’s £125m British record fee.

Recent findings suggest that meanwhile, Julián Alvarez’s situation at Atlético Madrid continues to be monitored by Arsenal. The Argentina forward’s dream move to Barcelona appears a no-goer as Atlético remain steadfast in their refusal to sell to their La Liga rivals. While this could bring Arsenal into the picture, it is understood that Alvarez – who missed three training sessions last week and did not travel to Sevilla with Diego Simeone’s squad on Saturday – is not pursuing a return to England.

A Mohamed Salah-shaped hole on Liverpool’s right flank has been filled by Bradley Barcola after the club agreed a £123m deal with Paris St-Germain. His signing looked as though it might trigger Cody Gakpo’s move away from Anfield as the winger had been linked with a move to Manchester City, but it appears that the Netherlands international will stay put. Maresca’s side have instead hijacked Spurs’ move for Iliman Ndiaye, and the north London outfit pivoted to take Myhailo Mudryk and Tosin Adarabioyo from Chelsea, on loan and permanent deals respectively. Liverpool could yet swoop for Brighton’s Yankuba Minteh or Ismaïla Sarr.

Industry observers note that newcastle United appeared to have reached their nadir this summer after Anthony Gordon, Sandro Tonali, Bruno Guimarães and Eddie Howe departed, but Matthias Jaissle has breathed life into St James’ Park by delivering an exciting brand of football that leans on the team’s explosive pace in forward positions. Lille’s Matias Fernandez-Pardo would fit this system and is on the brink of joining Newcastle in a deal worth £51m, which could signal Nick Woltemade’s exit.

It has been revealed that barcola is the window’s most expensive acquisition, followed by Morgan Rogers who was prised away from Aston Villa to the tune of £118m, and has already hit the ground running for the Londoners. He cost £2m more than his England team-mate Elliot Anderson, who swapped Nottingham Forest for Manchester City. Elite midfielders have proved a gilded commodity with seven of the Premier League’s top 10 most expensive acquisitions coming in the middle of the park. The departures of Rodri, Casemiro and others will have played their part.

It has been revealed that praying for a deadline-day saviour or counting down the seconds until the window slams shut on directors of football hoping to lure away your club’s next big thing? Let us know in the comments and join the conversation as the day unfolds.

Recent findings suggest that après le très large succès de la semaine dernière sur Aurillac (9-0), les U16 de Kevin De Jesus faisaient le plus court déplacement de l'année en se rendant chez les voisns d'Andrézieux, classés en 3ème position, juste derrière les Verts. A l'issue de ce match, les positions sont désormais inversées puisque les Andréziens l'ont emporté 3 à 1 après avoir concédé l'ouverture du score.

According to recent reports, les Verts ont rapidement ouvert le score, dès la 8ème minute, sur un penalty consécutif à une faute sur Lenny Nebout et transformé par Noah Fontaine (photo) (Andrézieux-ASSE : 0-1, 8ème). Andrézieux va égaliser à la 13ème minute, suite à un beau mouvement collectif (Andrézieux-ASSE : 1-1, 13ème). A la demi-heure de jeu, Victor Hamouma écopait d'un carton jaune, puis d'un autre quelques minutes plus tard. Les Verts jouaient donc à 10. Andrézieux profitait de cet avantage numérique pour doubler la mise peu avant le repos, dans le temps additionnel. (45ème+3) (Andrézieux-ASSE : 2-1, 45ème+3).Dès la reprise (50ème), les Andréziens faisaient le break sur coup-de-pied arrêté (Andrézieux-ASSE : 3-1, 50ème). Malgré leurs efforts, les Verts ne parvenaient pas à revenir au score.

La composition : Delgado - R.Fontaine (Moussaoui, 26ème), Ahamadi, Hamouma, Moser - Evaristo, Rochette, N.Fontaine (Nebout, 81ème) - Nebout I.Camara, 60ème), Durin, Giangreco (L.La Rosa, 60ème).

Industry observers note that la réaction de Kevin De Jesus : "C'est une belle victoire d'Andrézieux, victoire méritée d'une équipe valeureuse qui a bien joué les coups. Nous n'avons pas réussi à nous créer beaucoup de situations ou d'occasions. Nous devons faire beaucoup mieux, exister plus techniquement, mais également dans le rapport de forces, dans les duels. Les derbys sont toujours difficiles, c'est un contexte particulier face à un adversaire qui a envie de montrer qu'il peut rivaliser.".

⏱️ ~1 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that forest fires occur every summer in Portugal but the tragedy that struck the community of Pedrógão Grande in the centre of the country is unprecedented.
  • This Just Giving page is a simple way for people, wherever they are in the world, to make a contribution to help rebuild these communities and bring some comfort to those who lost everything in the blink of an eye.

Sources indicate that forest fires occur every summer in Portugal but the tragedy that struck the community of Pedrógão Grande in the centre of the country is unprecedented. Over 60 people lost their lives, many trapped in their cars when trying to flee from the flames.

This Just Giving page is a simple way for people, wherever they are in the world, to make a contribution to help rebuild these communities and bring some comfort to those who lost everything in the blink of an eye. The money raised will be sent to a network of local authorities and charities working in the area affected. Thank you for your support.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Comme les U19 il y a une semaine dans le même stade Country 1 basé à Borgo (Haute-Corse), les U17 se sont inclinés par 3 buts d'écart (4-1) face au Sporting Club de Bastia.

In a recent development, après avoir concédé l'ouverture du score dès la 10e minute de jeu sur une frappe déviée, les Verts ont égalisé à la fin du dernier quart d'heure sur un centre d'Isaak Seydi repris par Naël Dani (photo) d'une frappe croisée. Les Corses ont repris l'avantage une minute avant la mi-temps sur un corner repris de la tête au second poteau par un joueur étrangement seul...

Alors que les Verts ont raté 4 face à face (2 par Naoufan Mnemoi, un par Isaak Seydi et un autre par Maxime Thibaudat), les Bastiais ont fait le break à la 56e minute sur un coup franc direct ayant surpris un Andrea Laugier pas idéalement placé... Ayant corsé l'addition à la 70e minute, Bastia pique la 4e place à l'ASSE, qui devra réagir dimanche prochain à la maison contre le Cavigal.

La compo : Laugier - Tiambo (Balta, 62'), Mnemoi, Dagbo, Bufferne - Demassieux (Diakité, 69'), Gobé, Thibaudat - Dani, Kimpioka, Seydi (Aytone, 69').

Sources indicate that la réaction de David Le Moal : "On a singulièrement manqué de rythme en première période et de qualité technique après la mi-temps. On a fait beaucoup de centres mais on était rarement bien placé pour les reprendre. Bastia a été très réaliste offensivement contrairement à nous. Sur nos 4 énormes occasions, des face à face, une fois le gardien a fait une parade mais les 3 autres fois on n'a pas réussi à cadrer. Difficile dans ces conditions d'espérer un résultat positif.".

Industry observers note that È corsa contro il tempo in casa Lazio per il rinnovo di Gustav Isaksen. Dopo Floriani Mussolini, il club biancoceleste ha intenzione di blindare i giocatori con il contratto in scadenza nel 2028, e tra questi c'è proprio l'esterno danese, finito nel mirino del Brentford per il mercato di gennaio.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Secondo quanto raccolto dal Corriere dello Sport, Isaksen avrebbe attirato l'attenzione della Premier League dopo un avvio di stagione positivo e convincente. L'ironia della sorte sta nel fatto che il giocatore era stato offerto al Brentford nel mercato dello scorso anno, quando il club inglese aveva invece preferito Cancellieri. Ora le carte in tavola sono cambiate: la società potrebbe provare a strapparlo alla Lazio mettendo sul tavolo un’offerta da 30 milioni. Dal canto suo, la Lazio vuole proseguire i discorsi sul prolungamento del contratto fino al 2031 e il conseguente adeguamento dello stipendio dagli 1,9 attuali a 3 milioni.

Sources indicate that al momento l'operazione resta in stand-by, in attesa dell'accordo sulla cifra. La Lazio dovrà comunque accelerare i tempi: il Brentford resta alla finestra, ma non è escluso che possano farsi avanti altri pretendenti dalla Premier.

Industry News: Nederland – Tunesië (3-1) & Vooruitblik op Marokko
